message: Activation-safe remote enforcement. Removes the v10.0.18 10-15 second false binding shutdown. The activation page is now an explicit non-playable state and may remain open indefinitely while a key is entered. Remote enforcement is bound primarily to the stable Windows-protected device.dat hardware identity and supplemented by a broad native localhost /api/status discovery that probes all listeners instead of assuming one PID/port. Once Hardware ID or License ID is known, the Supabase authority is checked every 250 ms; HTTP 403 immediately terminates the protected core and localhost app-mode browser. Temporary status discovery loss no longer closes a valid activated session because the latched device identity remains authoritative. Offline play remains disabled.
